data.name: 风吟战记：巨龙残歌
data.detailed_description:
Building a game that is full of fantasy elements is both exciting and challenging. Eventually we built a game which embodied the essence of JRPGs. Here you will travell around an ideal world beyond your imagination, encountering with various races and species, witnessing those dancing elves travelling around the world along with wandering bards. As for exotic landscapes and architecture of diverse styles, there are magical Astral Spires, kingdoms that have slumbered for millennia, and many more regions for you to explore.

Along this journey, a destined encounter awaits between you and your companions . Together, you will not only fight together with these valuable partners, but also forge your destiny and ultimately create a heroic epic of your legend.

This expansive realm now lies fully open before your eyes. Unveil its profound mysteries by yourself!

【The Story】

“In ages old, there lay a continent where the Giant and the Dragon slept,

The Giant skilled in crafts, the Dragon in magic.

It came to pass that they waged a fierce war.

The Giant perished, becoming the land we now behold,

While the Dragon flesh fell, transforming to galaxies, illuminating the continent.

Thousands of years has the land slept through strife and peace as we see.

An ignorant youth, who soars across this realm,

Pulls out the Dragon Sword bearing his lofty responsibility.

And sets forth anew to quell the war of a thousand ages.”

【Key Features】

· Satisfying combo-based combat system: Arranging basic elements to produce combo buffs as well as additional status. Think of strategies to maximize the attack multiplier!

· Special Roguelike designs: Apart from colourful stories, players can experience repeated satisfaction of success through our unique Challenge system

· Settings full of JRPG’s characteristics: Experience all kinds of adventures while traveling around the continent, befriend a cast of distinctive characters, compose a song of love and heroism.

· Special character development system: Players can cultivate various characters while uncovering their inner stories and experiencing their distinctive charm.

【Characters】

【The Legendary Rookie Hero-Alex】

Our hero’s name is Alex, a rookie soldier of the Icarus Guard Corps. In his daily time, this lazy boy always seizes every opportunity to escape from his training,. Therefore, he often gets caught and scolded by his superiors. Fortunately, his commanders still care a lot about him and expect his success. Alex would plead with his commanders and other senior officers to learn more sword skills.

Beyond his role as a soldier, Alex is also addicted to books, especially those about heroes from the imperial capital. He dreams that one day he can become a true hero as well. What thrilling adventures await him on his journey? Find it out yourself!

【Mysterious girl weaving through the shadows of trees-Sarana】

Sarana is a dark elf. One day, she suddenly fell from the magic forest and was saved by Alex. She can't stand foolish people, but somehow, she still formed a bond with this rookie.

 Now, with a young wolf by her side and carrying her clan's deep distrust of humans, she is slowly and carefully getting closer to the human world.

What goals and secrets is she hiding? How will their encounter change the fate of this land? The story will slowly unfold...

【The Holy Maiden Entwined by Fate - Eskoll】

A nun who carries the ancient dragon's power. She was fleeing from the dark elves with her maid when Alex and his companions saved them. Why would she offend the dark elves? What secrets lie between her, the dark elves and the Imperial Capital?

By the way, her body contains the ancient dragon's power which is in a dormant state at present. How is this power connected to the dragon, the Empire, and the fate of the whole continent?

The forgotten ancient dragon and the epic tales of the old continent will gradually reveal themselves with every step of their journey...

【Others】

More character and game components are waiting for you to discover! Please follow us and wait for next update!

data.short_description: The Dragon left elusive traces in the world, dancing elves and wandering bards travelling along the world. The magical Astral Spires, slumbered kingdoms, and many more regions are waiting for you to explore. Enter this world with your companions and finally create a heroic epic of your legend!
